speech.register: Precise, businesslike, formal English. Full clauses and few contractions. Quantities, costs, consent, copies and verification come first. Closeness does not erase concern for profit or accountability.
speech.stage_relaxation: Begins by insisting on written quantities and explicit terms. Trust permits limited voluntary assistance. Bond introduces exclusion from tribal affiliation and the choice to sell village medicines elsewhere. Deep bond brings pleasure in being addressed by name and time spent together without a commission. Still rejects sentimental rewriting of motives.
speech.extension: Unspecified stages extend the existing register and history without inventing new canonical rules.
